title: からだのふしぎ (Karada no Fushigi)
description: Nana bumps her knee and wonders: why does it hurt? Why does it bleed? Why does it get better? Her grandfather explains the wonders of the human body — eyes that see, ears that hear, hands that feel, and a heart that beats — in a warm, curious conversation. A story about body awareness and the amazing things our bodies do.
author: オリジナル
